name: MV switchgear and ring main units (11-33 kV)
description: 11 kV and 33 kV metal-clad or gas-insulated switchgear and compact ring main units used at TNB intake points and site substations, built to IEC 62271-200/60298.

subtypes.name: Ring main unit (RMU) with load-break switches and fuse or T-off

specifications.basis: 8DJH datasheet covers 7.2, 12, 15, 17.5 and 24 kV ratings; TNB distributes at 11 kV and 33 kV

source.note: Siemens 8DJH 24 kV datasheet, read from PDF 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: 8DJH datasheet: busbar rated continuous current 630 A

source.note: Siemens 8DJH 24 kV datasheet, read from PDF 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: internal arc classification, Siemens 8DJH at 12 kV
specifications.basis: 8DJH: short-time withstand 25 kA for 1 s up to 17.5 kV (20-21 kA for 3 s); optional IAC A FL/FLR 21 kA 1 s

source.note: Siemens 8DJH 24 kV datasheet, read from PDF 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: 8DJH datasheet: partition class PM, loss of service continuity LSC 2, type-tested to IEC 62271-200

source.note: Siemens 8DJH 24 kV datasheet, read from PDF 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: ABB product scope table: max rated continuous current (busbar) 630 A for both the SF6 and the SF6-free SafeRing Air/SafePlus Air ranges

source.note: ABB SafeRing/SafePlus product scope table, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: rated voltage and short-time withstand, ABB SafeRing/SafePlus
specifications.basis: ABB product scope: up to 40.5 kV; short-time withstand up to 20 kA for 3 s at 24 kV and up to 25 kA for 3 s at 12/36/40.5 kV (SF6-free Air variant: up to 24 kV, 20 kA for 3 s). SF6 tank sealed for life over 30 years with leakage below 0.1% per year

source.note: ABB SafeRing/SafePlus product scope and SF6 enclosure description, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: Xiria 630 technical data table: rated voltage 3.6, 7.2, 12, 17.5 and 24 kV; impulse withstand 40-125 kV, power-frequency withstand 10-50 kV for 1 min

source.note: Eaton Xiria 630 Technical information table, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: busbar current and peak withstand, Eaton Xiria 630
specifications.basis: Xiria 630: load-break switch and circuit-breaker rated current 630 A; rated peak withstand current 50 kA; short-time withstand 20 kA for 1 s or 20 kA for 3 s

source.note: Eaton Xiria 630 busbar and circuit-breaker tables, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: Xiria 630: IAC AFLR 21 kA for 1 s (16 kA with absorber or cable compartment). Classification LSC2, partition class PM, degree of protection IP3X in service, ambient -25 to +40 C. SF6-free: switching and insulation by vacuum

source.note: Eaton Xiria 630 general table and SF6-free description, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: Schneider RM6 facts: gas-insulated RMU up to 24 kV, standard IEC 62271-200, 50 or 60 Hz

source.note: Schneider Electric Malaysia RM6 product range page (Facts about RM6), read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: busbar and switching currents, Schneider RM6
specifications.basis: RM6: busbar and load-break switch 630 A; circuit breaker 200 A for transformer protection or 630 A for feeder protection; single busbar system

source.note: Schneider RM6 facts, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: short-circuit and arc ratings, Schneider RM6
specifications.basis: RM6: short-circuit rated current up to 21 kA for 1 s; internal arc classification up to 20 kA AFLR with options; loss of service continuity LSC 2 A, partition class PM

source.note: Schneider RM6 facts, read in browser 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: indicative cost, 12-24 kV SF6 RMU, unit
specifications.basis: Indicative B2B listings: compact SF6 RMUs about USD 2,000-2,700, mainstream 12-24 kV units USD 3,400-4,700, outdoor GIS RMU USD 6,000-7,100; Western-brand equipment typically 2-4x these FOB figures. Indicative only, not a quote.

specifications.metric: TNB 11 kV motorised RMU supply contract value (benchmark, not unit price)
specifications.basis: TNB Letter of Award to EPE Switchgear (60% subsidiary of Pekat Group) for 11 kV motorised RMUs with interconnectors and remote control boxes, various configurations, two-year term from 29 December 2025; RM113.31 million inclusive of SST. A multi-configuration supply contract, so it bounds rather than fixes a per-unit price.

source.note: Bursa Malaysia announcement GA1-31122025-00042 (Pekat Group/EPE Switchgear), cross-reported by NST/Business Today, 2026-11-13

vendor_models.range: 7.2-24 kV type-tested, SF6 sealed for life

sources.note: TNB MV voltage and fault-level tables, read 2026-11-13

gaps.why: Manufacturer price books are distributor-only; only indicative B2B listings and the TNB contract total were found
gaps.next_action: Ask a TNB-registered Malaysian switchgear supplier (EPE Switchgear, Inteflex, others) for a per-unit benchmark

notes: Ratings for all four vendor families now come from the manufacturers' own pages read in an interactive browser 2026-11-13: Siemens 8DJH (PDF), ABB SafeRing/SafePlus (product scope table), Schneider RM6 (Malaysia product range page), Eaton Xiria 630 (technical data table). The ABB figures corrected an earlier search-summary version: the range goes to 40.5 kV and 25 kA for 3 s at 12/36/40.5 kV, not 24 kV/21 kA.
